title: Review of c30's Hash Chemistry knobs: replicates on fresh seeds 5-7; the static landscape freezes (0-19 late significant kinds, at or below the shadow), kill-the-winner crowding delays the freeze to t=5000-12000 but every run ends frozen, and re-salting every 2000 steps keeps new kinds coming to the end with full replacement
summary: Ran c30's sweep (my copy of sweep_run.py with its output path fixed to this directory; world.py and o_measure unchanged) for 20000 steps on fresh seeds 5, 6, 7 in three arms. Static landscape: late (t >= 2000) significant kinds 0, 19, 0 vs the neutral shadow's 9, 43, 13; the last new kind appears at t=1000-8000; top-20 overlap with steps 0-1000 at the end 0.5-0.85. Crowding 0.3 (n0 2000): 198, 12, 70 late kinds vs shadow 0, last new kind at t=12000, 5000, 5000, then none for the last 8000-15000 steps; top-20 overlap 0.05-0.4. Re-salt every 2000 steps: 1051, 1568, 1832 late kinds vs shadow 19-21, new kinds in the last window (t=19000) of every run, top-20 overlap 0.0. Every number falls in the range c30 reports for seeds 0-2, so the finding holds: in this world only the exogenous moving landscape (by construction) gives sustained novelty with replacement by the cohort measure.

observations.finding: summary.txt: static late kinds 0/19/0 (shadow 9/43/13), frozen after t=1000-8000; crowding 198/12/70 (shadow 0), frozen after t=12000/5000/5000; resalt 1051/1568/1832 (shadow 19-21), new kinds at t=19000 in 3/3, top-20 overlap 0.0

controls_run.finding: per-run RB neutral shadow (o_measure.shadow) and the static arm on the same seeds

verdicts.limitation: Three of the finding's six arms re-run (mixing and mutation-rate arms not re-run); one salt per run. c30's sweep_run.py writes to a malformed path (a literal string) and fails as published; I fixed the path in my copy only. The labkit run (labkit_static, t=1200) is a short visual check of the particle world; the cohort measure, not labkit, carries the result.
